skill.name: code-reviewer
skill.description: Review MERN stack projects for build health, security, maintainability, performance, testing, and architecture issues.
skill.summary: Guides structured MERN stack code reviews with project-health and security checklists.
skill.author: 9tykeshav

security_audit.summary: No malicious code or prompt-injection text was found in the reviewed skill files. Most static high-risk matches are false positives from markdown examples and checklists, but the skill does instruct agents to run local project commands and a file-size shell pipeline.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to run local project commands during project-health checks.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before running `tsc --noEmit`, `npm audit`, or shell pipelines, and explain any network or local tooling impact.

remediation.issue: The file-size command uses xargs without null-delimited filenames.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the pipeline with a safer null-delimited variant or ask the agent to use a structured file-size tool when available.

remediation.issue: Reference examples trigger many static detections because dangerous patterns appear as inline code.
remediation.suggestion: Label examples more explicitly as non-executable review examples to reduce marketplace scanner noise.

content.user_title: Review MERN Code for Security and Quality
content.value_statement: MERN projects hide security, performance, and maintainability issues across several layers. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused reviews.
actual_capabilities: Guides project health checks for builds, tests, docs, large files, and dependencies.
Provides a prioritized MERN review workflow and report format.
Covers security, maintainability, performance, testing, and architecture checklists.
Includes reference guidance for React, Express, Node.js, MongoDB, security, and full-stack flows.
Highlights critical red flags such as hardcoded secrets, unsafe eval, localStorage tokens, and missing auth.
Calibrates review depth for a single file, commit, feature branch, or full repository.
limitations: Requires access to the target codebase and permission to inspect files.
Command-based checks only run when the user or agent executes them.
Focuses on MERN and Node.js projects, not native mobile or non-JavaScript stacks.
Business-logic flaws may require domain context from the project owner.

use_cases.title: Audit an API Before Release
use_cases.description: Review Express and MongoDB code for auth gaps, injection risks, unsafe secrets, and performance problems.

use_cases.title: Review a React Feature
use_cases.description: Check components, hooks, state management, accessibility, XSS risks, and render performance before merging.

use_cases.title: Triage Repository Health
use_cases.description: Assess build status, tests, large files, deployment blockers, and high-priority fixes across a MERN repository.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small project or feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this MERN project for the highest-risk issues. Start with project health, then summarize security, tests, performance, and maintainability.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the changed files in this branch. Prioritize blockers, security issues, broken tests, and regressions. Include file and line evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Security and Auth
prompt_templates.scenario: Security-focused review of a backend or full-stack flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the auth, API, and data-access code for MERN security risks. Focus on secrets, injection, CORS, JWT handling, rate limits, and access control.

prompt_templates.title: Perform a Release Gate Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Act as the release reviewer for this MERN repository. Check project health, deployment blockers, critical security risks, architectural concerns, and test coverage.

output_examples.input: Review an Express API before release.
output: Project health: build not checked, tests found, no deployment blocker found.
Critical: auth endpoints do not show rate limiting.
Important: list endpoints need pagination and field selection.
Scope: changed React components and API hooks.
Important: one effect can race during fast navigation.
Suggestion: add accessibility coverage for modal keyboard behavior.
Main blockers: failing type checks and a large service file.
Next step: fix build errors before deeper architecture work.

best_practices: Start every broad review with build status, tests, docs, file size, and dependency health.
Report concrete evidence with file and line references for each issue.
Load reference guidance only when the reviewed code needs MERN-specific checks.
anti_patterns: Do not classify style preferences as critical defects.
Do not claim no issues were found without searching relevant files.
Do not report findings from files that were not reviewed.

faq.question: What projects does this skill fit best?
faq.answer: It fits MERN projects using React, Express, Node.js, and MongoDB.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide test and build checks, but execution depends on the active agent and user permissions.

faq.question: Can it review only one file?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow supports single-file, commit, feature branch, and full-repository scopes.

faq.question: Does it include security review?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers auth, secrets, injection, XSS, CORS, JWT handling, and dependency risks.

faq.question: Can it fix issues after review?
faq.answer: The skill asks the agent to offer fixes, starting with critical issues.

faq.question: What evidence should users expect?
faq.answer: Review output should include file and line references, impact, severity, and a recommended fix.
